artworks.title: Microfilm cards envelope, "a few circles" and "circle dwg proj"
artworks.description: Pale green Bell System microfilm cards envelope, labeled in pencil "a few circles, T1079" and "circle dwg proj, T1071". Contains two microfilm cards, one of graphic with some overlapping circles, and some horizontal lines crossing them (Snumb: T1079, Time: 9.387 Hrs, Date: 6/21/67), the other with a dense field of overlapping circles and lines with a strong glow effect (Snumb: T1071, Time: 15.466 Hrs, Date: 6/20/67).

artworks.title: Microfilm cards envelope, "Spectrum Positive"
artworks.description: Pale green Bell System microfilm cards envelope, labeled in pencil "Spectrum Positive". Contains smaller manila envelope, itself containing 5 positives and one negative of graphics. One larger positive of a column of circles made up of intersecting horizontal and vertical lines, growing more dense with each circle. One positive of a circle made up of intersecting horizontal and vertical lines. Two positives of grids of circles, either empty or filled, the filled circles giving off a fuzzy aura, one positive with more filled circles than the other. One positive of five rows of five shapes in the arrangement: triangle, circle, square, circle, triangle, with each shape having a series of the same shape receding behind it toward a focal point at the center. One negative of a circle composed of intersecting horizontal and vertical lines, with patches of the circle empty of lines.

artworks.title: Microfilm cards envelope, "lightbuttons series with slight flare"
artworks.description: Pale green Bell System microfilm cards envelope, labeled in ink "lightbuttons series with slight flare". Contains nine microfilm cards of a series of graphics depicting a grid of circles, either empty or filled, the filled circles giving off a fuzzy aura, and with varying numbers of filled circles, ranging from less than half to all filled. (Snumb: T1547, Time: 23.477 Hrs, Date: 7/18/67, Page No. 1-10 [No. 4 not present]).

artworks.title: Microfilm cards envelope, "T1149 GSP III 8/15 succeed"
artworks.description: Pale green Bell System microfilm cards envelope, labeled in pencil "T1149 GSP III 8/15 succeed". Contains six microfilm cards (two series of three graphics) and one loose microfilm strip. The first set of three microfilm cards (Snumb: R0123, Time: 11.088 Hrs, Date: 8/9/67, Page No. 1-3) depicting incomplete or failed attempts at the graphic, with ink notes inscribed on the backs: Page No. 1 "of interest", Page No. 2: "of no interest", Page No. 3: "good material". Second set of three cards (Snumb: T1149, Time: 13.394 Hrs, Date: 8/15/67, Page No. 1-3) with 3 slightly different, seemingly succesful graphics of partial grids of the letters "G", "S", and "P" populated randomly. Loose microfilm strip containing all three successful "GSP" graphics.

artworks.title: Microfilm cards envelope (inscription illegible)
artworks.description: Pale green Bell System microfilm cards envelope, pencil inscription present but illegible ("nop slap +-" ?). Contains one microfilm card with graphic of a field of dots arranged in waves/ripples/clusters forming a pattern. (Snumb: T1158, Time: 18.016 Hrs, Date: 8/15/67).

artworks.description: Roman capitals A-Z. Classic, Trajan-like proportions. Small V, X, Y, Z. Signature on left. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 10 and 11
artworks.description: Capitals A-Z with a lot of A's for a textural experiment on the left-hand sheet. Letterforms are more classically (Trajan column) proportioned. Signature on left. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 18 and 19
artworks.description: Very large E, F, G. Smaller H, I, J, K, L. E and J extremely flourished. K and L have long terminals. No signature. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 20 and 21
artworks.description: Very large M. Smaller N. Italics with flourishing. M has dry brush effect on left stem. White out used to refine letterforms. No signature. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 28 and 29
artworks.description: Capital V and W. Flourish underneath. White out used to refine letterforms. No signature. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 52 and 53
artworks.description: Lowercase a-z. Repeated letterforms with ascenders and descenders to create a picket fence effect. Multiple f's, h's, l's, p's, q's, s's (with descenders). White out used to refine the d, e, l's, o, p's, and q's. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 54 and 55
artworks.description: Lowercase a-z. Repeated letterforms, long connecting terminals, and a lot of leading. Multiple a's, d's, f's, g's, and s's. Relatively short ascenders and descenders that don't overlap with baselines above or below. Four lines of lettering that create a "spacious" alphabet. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 56 and 57
artworks.description: Lowercase a-z. Bunches of repeated letterforms. Letters a-i are in the top third of the page, j-p the middle third, and q-z the bottom third. Letterforms seem to be the result of a "flicking" with the brush. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 76 and 77
artworks.description: Lowercase a-z with huge y's and tiny y's for texture. Alphabet is primarily near the bottom: a-g and t-x in one bunch on the left, h-i together in the middle, j-l to the right of that, and m-s and x-z together in a final bunch on the right. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 78 and 79
artworks.description: Lowercase a-z with a huge number of a's on both the left-hand page and right-hand page for a burst of texture. Alphabet sits on five lines on the right side of the right-hand page. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Spread: 82 and 83
artworks.description: Capital A-Z with repeated capital E's. Letterforms are in bunches with extra E's floating around. Left-hand page has S-V, Y-Z, and L-R. Right-hand page has W-X and A-K. White out used to refine L, M, N, O, Q and A, B, D, G, H, I. Sheets: 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm Spread: 60.7 cm x 91 cm

artworks.title: Calligraphic alphabets: 1982 1-page
artworks.description: 3 alphabets, 3 sheets. (1) Lowercase a-z. Two-line strokes (one thick, sometimes broken, and one thinner). Long terminals on c, e, f, i, l, n, u, and z. Repeated i and r. Extensive tearing, discoloring, and folding along bottom edge. (2) Three bunches of (maybe?) complete alphabets written in a circle, with ascenders and descenders sticking out. The middle of the bunches has scoring from (probably?) the edge of the writing utensil. Tape along right side with no obvious second page attached. (3) Lowercase a-z. Two-line strokes. Top two lines of lettering use a two-line stroke with a thick and a thin. Letters a-j on top, l-q in middle, and r-z on bottom. Signature quite small bottom right. Foundational forms with an f that doesn't have a descender. Bottom right corner torn. (1): 45.5 cm x 60.7 cm (2) and (3): 60.7 cm x 45.5 cm

artworks.title: Calligraphic alphabets: 1983 colored
artworks.description: 4 alphabets, 4 sheets. (1) Lowercase a-z. Background has one large green rectangle, and three burnt sienna rectangles of different sizes. The descender on the g is quite expressive (disjointed and has a dry-brush effect). The q and r are on their own to the left side of the piece. (2) Lowercase a-z. Background stippling is red on top, burnt sienna in the middle, and green on the bottom. Alphabet is quite contrasty (very thick thicks and very thin things). Signature on bottom right suggests the piece was created from 1983–1984. (3) Lowercase a-z. Background is a rectangle with a red border. One section is green (the counters of the alphabet are colored burnt sienna) and the other section is burnt sienna with green-colored counters. The letter a is very, very wide. The single thin stroke of the d extends really far out to the left. (4) Lowercase a-z. Background has stipping that mixes green with burnt sienna and red. There are multiple d's, g's, o's and x's. Signature centered.

artworks.title: "Signac" graph paper sketches
artworks.description: 2 alphabets, 2 sheets. (1) Has a blue sticky that reads "100% signac". The lowercase alphabet has a double-storey a and g. Has letters a-v. Heavy white out use to refine letterforms. Letterforms have serifs and ascenders and descenders of equal length. (2) The lowercase italic alphabet might go with (1). The a is a single-storey a. This is a complete alphabet, but the s has only been outlined and not filled. Also has heavy white out use to refine letterforms.

artworks.title: Untitled typeface paste-up
artworks.description: 4 sheets, 1 folded, 1 with cut out. (1) Small scale lettering. Missing v, w, ? (left of the !). Ligatures to the right are torn (fl maybe?). Tape extremely yellowed and missing in places. This piece is a little fragile since the tape has become brittle. Heavily notated with "enlarge" and "reduce." (2) Uppercase alphabet A-Z, !, ?. (3) Numbers 0-9 and 2 ampersands. (4) Lowercase a-z with a "capital Q." Folded sheet that forms an informal folder for the rest of the pieces. (1) 38.5 cm x 51.2 cm (2) 38.7 cm x 51.2 cm (3) 29.7 cm x 51.2 cm (4) unfolded: 66.1 cm x 51.2 cm

artworks.title: Untitled: complete upper and lowercase alphabets
artworks.description: Lots of white out to refine letterforms and throughout the sheet. Upright alphabet with script elements (like the flick at the top of the d, on the g and o. The lowercase q is a "small capital" q. Single story a, oldstyle g. Uppercase N has a flick on the right-most stem. Condition notes: Paper quite discolored, Upper left has a shoe print and is creased. A lot of tearing and creasing in the upper right of the sheet. Line 1: a-q. Line 2: r-z. Line 3: A-J. Line 4: K, L, L-N, R, O, P. Line 5: T, U, W, X. Line 6: Y, Z, V, S.

artworks.title: Untitled: caligraphe qu
artworks.description: Baker seems to be experimenting with four styles: a "classic" lowercase roman with serifs (although the e seems to be a little round), next is a bolder (smaller) experiment with pointy descenders and a "disconnected" g, then a very informal, playful style with unconventional thicks and thins (the a's and k's are particularly notable), and finally, an italic with elements of all of the above (pointed descenders, disconnected g's, and unconventional thicks and thins (look at the e in "over"). Condition notes: Yellowed tape and tape residue. Wavy shoe prints throughout the left, top, and bottom edges. Torn corners in the upper right and left.

artworks.title: Untitled: 2 complete lowercase
artworks.description: Top two alphabets are classic lowercase serifs: roman and italic. There is a nib ladder next to the n on the second line. Bottom two alphabets have single story a's and g's with different ascender heights. Very bottom line of letters has consistent ascender height except the last ascender on the k (which looks like it's the height of the ascenders from the line above). Condition notes: Torn edge on the bottom. Fairly good condition, overall.

artworks.title: Untitled: 5 complete lowercase alphabets
artworks.description: Five different styles of lowercase letters. Top alphabet is the "quirkiest." The largest alphabet at the bottom is a classic roman with serifs. Condition notes: Overally, good condition. A little staining near the fold on the left edge.

artworks.title: Lo-Res
artworks.description: 1 folder containing 47 pieces, including some material in plastic folders, stapled sheets, hand drawn letterforms on graph paper, print tests of character sets, correspondence, hand notes, calculations, checklists, ’The New Primitives’ article, draft text for press release, and ’Digital Typefaces’ Emigre marketing poster. Captions for shown selects are as follows: 1. Folder containing sketches and notes regarding the transition from early bitmap edited fonts (Emigre, Emperor, Oakland and Universal) to postscript fonts (Lo-Res family). All designs by Zuzana Licko, except where indicated, 1985-2000. 2. Sharpie pen sketches on grid paper by Rudy VanderLans, circa 1985. 3.Sharpie pen sketches on grid paper by Rudy VanderLans, circa 1985. 4.Laserwriter printout of bitmap fonts, circa 1985-1986. 5.Laserwriter printout of bitmap fonts with “Smooth” printing option turned off, circa 1985-1986. 6. Laserwriter printout of bitmap fonts with “Smooth” printing option turned on. Based on these results a separate set of bitmaps was designed, with adjustments to take advantage of the smoothing, for example, note the angled lead-in stroke on the lower case n and m and straight sided v and w. (see image 8: LFA_Emigre_0096_138.jpg) Years later, this smoothing effect inspired the design of Citizen, circa 1985-1986. 7. Laserwriter printout of character spacing tests of bitmap fonts Emigre, Emperor, Oakland and Universal, circa 1985-1986. 8.Advertisement for bitmap fonts, typesetting and design services published in Emigre #6, 1986. 9.Laserwriter printout with notes, Lo-Res 9 Wide Bold, circa 2000. 10. Laserwriter printout with notes, Lo-Res 9 Wide, circa 2000. 11.Laserwriter printout with notes, Lo-Res 9 Narrow, circa 2000. 12. Laserwriter printout of Lo-Res Plus and Lo-Res Minus variants. These counterparts to Lo-Res-Nine mimic the effect of photographically overexposing and underexposing, which become apparent when bitmaps are reproduced with such methods as photocopying, circa 2000. This exemplifies the improvement of output resolution from the "smoothened" bitmaps of 1986, when smoothing was a crude hack for improving resolution from screen to printer, to the high quality of printer output in 2000, when smoothing out bitmaps could be done with such control as to mimick another technology. 13. Laserwriter printout of illustrations explaining the design process of the Lo-Res family, circa 2000. 14. Laserwriter printout of text and sketches explaining the design process of the Lo-Res family, circa 2000. 15. Laserwriter printout of rearranging early bitmap fonts into comprehensive Lo-Res family, circa 2000. 16. Laserwriter printout of family tree of the Lo-Res family, circa 2000.

Mixed sans serif and serif fonts for text in black ink. Text reads: I knew God was BLACK but I didn't know they were FEMME!.

artworks.title: As the garden grows, so does the gardener
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. Background mix of repeated words related to gardens and vegetables including fresh, food for the people, peas, collards overlapping in yellow, orange, gold, green, and red ink on orange background. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Mixed sans serif and serif fonts for text in black ink. Text reads: As the garden grows, so does the gardener.

artworks.title: Living is worthless for one without a home
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. Background is repeated, overlapping silhouettes of Africa in blues, orange, purple, peach, pink, and silver ink on blue background. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Mixed sans serif and serif fonts in black ink. Text reads: Living is worthless for one without a home. A Proverb from Ethiopia.

artworks.title: Living is worthless for one without a home
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. Background is repeated, overlapping silhouettes of Africa in red, yellow, purple, pink, and blue ink on purple magneta background. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Mixed sans serif and serif fonts in black ink. Text reads: Living is worthless for one without a home. A Proverb from Ethiopia.

artworks.title: Sitting is being crippled
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. Background is repeated, overlapping silhouettes of Africa in dark blue, light blue, and yellow ink on silver background. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Mixed sans serif and serif fonts in black ink. Text reads: Sitting is being crippled. A Proverb from Ethiopia.

artworks.title: A wise woman who knows proverbs reconciles difficulties
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. Background is repeated, overlapping silhouettes of Africa in blue, yellow, white, and gold ink on blue background. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Mixed sans serif and serif fonts in black ink. Text reads: A wise woman who knows proverbs reconciles difficulties. A Yoruba Proverb.

artworks.title: A wise woman who knows proverbs reconciles difficulties
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. Background is repeated, overlapping silhouettes of Africa in green, yellow, white, red, pink and silver ink on purple background. African mask motif in red ink in lower right corner. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Mixed sans serif and serif fonts in black ink. Text reads: A wise woman who knows proverbs reconciles difficulties. A Yoruba Proverb.

artworks.title: It is the duty of children to wait on elders
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. Pink background with single African mask in silver ink behind the text. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Sans serif font in black ink. Text reads: It is the duty of children to wait on elders, and not the elders on children. -Kenya-

artworks.title: Racism is still with us
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. Background is repreated, overlapping text including the words segregation, Montgomery, bus in orange, blue, yellow, and silver inks. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Mixed sans serif and serif fonts, main text in black ink in sans serif font. Text reads: Racism is still with us. But it is up to us to prepare our children for what they have to meet, and hopefully, we shall overcome. Rosa Louise Parks.

artworks.title: Proceed and be bold!
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. Silver ink background. Printed on chipboard with black oil-based inks. Sans serif font for main text, Cooper serif font for text at top and bottom. Text reads: Architecture is about shelter for soul. PROCEED AND BE BOLD! Sambo Mockbee.

artworks.title: Children tired of being harrassed by your stupid parents?
artworks.description: Broadside, single-sided. CHILDREN and ACT NOW! in red ink, the rest printed in black ink. On uninked background. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Sans serif font. Text reads: Children tired of being harrassed by your stupid parents? Act now! Move out, get a job, pay your own bills, while you still know everything.

artworks.title: Power concedes nothing without a demand
artworks.description: Poster, single-sided. Text in black ink. All caps sans serif font in mix of blue, yellow, red, and green inks on uninked background. Printed on white poster board with oil-based inks. Small tear on lower left edge. Text reads: Power concedes nothing without a demand. It never did and it never will. Frederick Douglass.

artworks.title: Someone died for your right to vote
artworks.description: Alabama official 2007–2008 highway map with text "Someone died for your right to vote Viola Gregg Liuzzo shot to death on US HWY 80 Alabama on 25 March 1965. Fighting for your right to VOTE!" printed over image of the state, centered and in large sans serif letters in black ink. Red text at angle behind main text reads "Murdered in Alabama." Printed with oil-based inks. Original fold lines still visible.

artworks.title: I Would Like To Be Known As A Person Who Is Concerned About Freedom...
artworks.description: Rosa Parks quote printed in black over red and blue text in backbround.

artworks.title: Tupelo Honey Cafe, Knoxville, TN
artworks.artist: Kennedy Jr., Amos; Kennedy Prints!; Tupelo Honey Cafe
artworks.description: Poster, single-sided. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Mix of sans serif and serif fonts. Background is repeated text overlapping in green and silver ink, on ocher-inked background. Phrases in background include food descriptions such as "sweet potato pancakes", "goat cheese grits", "pecan pie". Text reads: Tupelo Honey Cafe, Konxville, TN. Okra, goat cheese grits, sweet potato pancakes, pecan pie.

artworks.title: Fire Moon
artworks.description: Text in black san serif font on top and bottom: Fire Moon. Illustration in center of a collapsing silo in black and silver ink. All on grey-inked color field. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: Alabama Silo
artworks.description: Text in black san serif font on top and bottom: Alabama Silo. Illustration in center of a collapsing silo in black and silver ink. All on grey-inked color field. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: We Demand The Very Best From Our Clients (red)
We Fight Get Beat Rise & Fight Again
artworks.description: Text in black san serif on green-inked color field: We Fight Get Beat Rise & Fight Again. General Nathanael Greene. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: Slavery has never been abolished...
artworks.description: Text in red san serif condensed font: SLAVERY. Text in black san serif font: Slavery has never been abolished form America's way of thinking. Nina Simone. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: Perfect Is The Enemy Of Great
artworks.description: Text in black san serif font: Perfect is the enemy of great. Background of purple and pink ink mix of san and serifted fonts: prefect. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: Farm to Eat. Eat to Live. Live to Bike...
artworks.artist: Kennedy Jr., Amos; Kennedy Prints!; Rising Pheasant Farms
artworks.description: Text in black serif font: Rising Pheasant Farms Farm to Eat. Eat to Live. Live to Bike. Bike to Farm. Grown in Detroit. Background is green inked text in mix of sans and serif fonts: grow, detroit. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Union bug: NRA (National Recovery Administration) "we do our part"

artworks.title: Visit the Belle Isle Aquarium
artworks.artist: Belle Isle Aquarium; Kennedy Jr., Amos; Kennedy Prints!
artworks.description: 2 pieces. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. An orange seahorse and green seaweed on light blue background. Small black cat in lower left corner. Text reads: Visit the Belle Isle Aquarium.

artworks.title: Bluegrass...2014
artworks.description: Text in black: Bluegrass & Gee's Bend 2014 (with a manicule). Text in green: Camp [something obscured]. Text in red: Alabama Folk School. Orange inked background. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks in mix of san and serif fonts.

artworks.title: Play it again
artworks.artist: Fairhope Film Festival; Kennedy Jr., Amos; Kennedy Prints!
artworks.description: Text in black ink and sans serif font: Play it again. Text in silver ink and sans serif font: Fairhope Film Festival. Blue to white ombre inked background. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: I Am Not A Misfit I Am A Pefect Fit -- Misfit series
artworks.description: Text in black ink and mixed fonts: I am not a misfit I am a perfect fit. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Two items: Background is text—creative, nomads—repeated and overlapping in various fonts in silver, brown, teal, and yellow on uninked background. Background is text—creative, nomads, Fargo,ND—repeated and overlapping in various fonts in silver, brown, neon pink, blue, and yellow on uninked background.

artworks.title: Visit the Belle Isle Aquarium
artworks.description: Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Three seahorses, two pink on either side of red, are centered behind text. A small black cat silhouette is visible in the lower left corner. Text reads: Visit the Belle Isle Aquarium

artworks.title: Get Smarter Every Day
artworks.description: Single-sided. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Sans serif font in black atop yellow background in oil-based ink. Text reads: Get Smarter Every Day.

artworks.title: Be A Thinker and Doer.
artworks.description: Text in black ink in sans serif: Be a thinker and doer. Background is inked orange. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: GOGGLE UP! Science is about to HAPPEN
artworks.description: Single-sided. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Sans serif font in black atop silver goggles and red background in oil-based ink. Text reads: GOGGLE UP! Science in about to HAPPEN

artworks.title: A good book is the purest essence of a human soul.
artworks.artist: Detroit Public Library; Kennedy Jr., Amos; Kennedy Prints!
artworks.description: 2 pieces. Single-sided. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Sans serif font in black atop background made of layered and illegible multicolor (greens, blues, silvers, blacks) text. Text reads: A good book is the purest essence of a human soul. Thomas Carlyle. Detroit Public Library.

artworks.title: The wealth of the mind is the only true wealth.
artworks.artist: Detroit Public Library; Kennedy Jr., Amos; Kennedy Prints!
artworks.description: Single-sided. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Sans serif font in black atop background made of layered, multicolor (Pinks, yellows, peaches, reds) text and image. Background layers include a few descernable elements: a pink illustration of someone reading in a window frames by books; the word books. Two layers of legible text in Cooper Black. Silver text reads: Support the Detroit Public Library. Black text (topmost) reads: The wealth of the mind is the only true WEALTH.

artworks.title: Diverse Books Need Us!
artworks.description: Text in black ink and mixed fonts: Diverse books need us! Office for Intellectual Freedom. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks. Two items: Background is inked pale pink Background is inked bright pink

artworks.title: Live On Edge...
artworks.description: Text in black ink in sans serif: Live On Edge... You Will Have A Better View. J.D. Chaddock. Background is inked lavender. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: I tell my students, it's got to be warm, dry and noble.
artworks.description: 2 pieces. Poster, single sided. Oil based ink on chipboard. Background is solid color with multiple layers of mixed-face text with final layer of black text in Cooper Black. One piece is reds and blues on orange. The other piece is blues, reds, and yellows, on red. Legible background layers read: Citizen; Citizen Architect; You should build dry warm shelters. Top layer text reads: I tell my students, it's got to be warm, dry and noble. Sambo Mockbee

artworks.title: It's not about your greatness as an architect...
artworks.description: 2 pieces. Poster, single sided. Oil based ink on chipboard. Background is solid color with multiple layers of mixed-face text with final layer of black text in Cooper Black. One piece is greens and blues on orange. The other piece is pinks and yellows, on brown. Legible background layers read: Citizen; Citizen Architect; You should build dry warm shelters. Top layer text reads: It's not about your greatness as an architect, but about your compassion. Sambo Mockbee

artworks.title: Don't Lick the Art
artworks.artist: Kennedy Jr., Amos; Kennedy Prints!; Rusted Willow Artworks
artworks.description: 2 pieces. Poster, single sided. Oil based ink on chipboard. Background is solid color with two multicolor chevrons. One piece is pink, blue, and white on orange. One piece is pink, blue, and white on yellow.Atop this is black text in mixed tyepfaces at the center and Cooper Black along the bottom. Text reads: Don't Link the Art, Rusted Willow Artworks.

artworks.title: Down the rabbit hole underground you will find your inner misfit.
artworks.description: Text in black ink in sans serif: Down the rabbit hole underground you will find your inner misfit. Illustration of scull and crossbones as well as a rabbit. Background is inked yellow. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: Hustle Copy Hack Provoke Pivot
artworks.description: Poster, single sided. Oil based ink on chipboard. Background is solid yellow. At the center top is a scull & crossbones in a certificate seal shape. Another scull & crossbones certificate seal is in brown in the center behind black san serif text. Text reads: Hustle Copy Hack Provoke Pivot

artworks.title: Innovation is a seed planted in YOU.
artworks.description: Poster, single sided. Oil based ink on chipboard. Background is solid yellow. At the center top is a scull & crossbones in a certificate seal shape. Black sans serif text is centered below. Innovation is a seed planted in you. Let it Grow!

artworks.title: A woman's work is never done
artworks.description: Text in black ink and mixed fonts: A woman's work is never done. Background is illegible text repeated and overlapping in various fonts in silver, on orange, covered over by a thin blue. Printed on chipboard with oil-based inks.

artworks.title: The Bricks Ybor presents... Kennedy Prints Detroit
artworks.description: Poster, single sided. Oil-based ink on chipboard. Background is made up of white, yellow, red, and blue layers of geometric patterns in a grid. Text in black ink is printed on top and set in Cooper Black. Text reads: The Bricks Ybor presents and exhibition of one thousand post cards by Kennedy Prints Detroit 4 December 2016 until 13 January 2017 1327 E 7th Ave Tampa, L

Poster, single sided. Oil-based ink on chipboard. Background is made up of green, brown, and red layers of geometric patterns in a grid. Text in black ink is printed on top in a fat sans serif. Text reads: 2+2=4

artworks.title: We ask for nothing that is not right, and herein lies the great power of our Demand.
artworks.description: Poster, single sided. Oil-based ink on chipboard. Background is made up of yellow, red, and blue layers of geometric patterns: lines and distorted grids. Text in black ink is printed on top and set in a sans serif font. Text reads: We ask for nothing that is not RIGHT, and herein lies the great power of our DEMAND. Paul Robeson

artworks.title: The artist must elect to fight for freedom
artworks.description: Poster, single sided. Oil-based ink on chipboard. Background is a red geometric grid on top of solid brown. Text in black ink is printed on top and set in a sans serif font. Text reads: The artist must elect to fight for FREEDOM or for slavery. I have made my choice. I had no alternative. Paul Robeson

artworks.title: Psycho City
artworks.description: Photograph. Crayone and Estria painting at the Psycho City parking lot in 1993 using a ladder. In the frame you can see two people painting, cans in crates setup near the wall, a skateboard and the back half of a car. Back reads: "Crayone & Estria TWS, San Francisco CA. 93, Joker".

artworks.title: Acme Beer Non-Fattening Yellow
artworks.artist: Acme Brewing Company; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Label with a background illustration of a woman holding lots of beer stiens, near a cellar, in a mountainous swiss scenery. Three styles of banner go over the background scene, with lots of small text below it and the plant name: "Acme Brewing Co. Los Angeles (Vernon), California". Pencil text is found in a few areas. Note that there are two of these that are strikingly similar, likely don by the same person. This is the yellow bordered label

artworks.title: Acme Beer Non-Fattening Blue
artworks.artist: Acme Brewing Company; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Label with a background illustration of a woman holding lots of beer stiens, near a cellar, in a mountainous swiss scenery. Three styles of banner go over the background scene, with lots of small text below it and the plant name: "Acme Brewing Co. Los Angeles (Vernon), California". Closely resembles the other Acme Beer design, with different shaped banners, and the cellar right instead of the left. Also contains pencil text, and pink drop shadow on the headline text. This is the blue bordered label.

artworks.title: H.S. Gile & Co. Loganberry Juice
artworks.artist: H.S. Gile & Company; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Three section label, with the sides totally uniform, decorative curling borders with gold, pink and green, There are lines drawn to show where text would likely go on the labels sides. The center panel has a green background and has a script H.S. Gile & Co along the top. Glued onto that is a graphic of a punchbowl, and the main text inside it. "Loganberry juice for punch or beverage, Prepared by H.S.Gile & Co. Salem Oregon".

artworks.title: Yak-O Club Beer (label on back)
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Yak-O Club
artworks.description: Two labels, one presumably to go on the neck of the bottle, and one for the main bottom of the bottle section. Both labels are attached to a black board. Both labels have pink border, with green outlined organic border made to look like branches amd plant stems, and a yellow background. Top label has rounded edges, and a red script reading: "A product of Quality". The larger label headline Yak-O Club is black sans serif capital letters with a red outline. Beer in the center is white and blue with a black outline and a double drop shadow of red and yellow. Below there are a few lines of text including the bottling company in Yakima Wash. on the top and bottom of the pink border, there are small pencil text lines. The borders of green borders on both labels show hops, and wheat plants.

artworks.title: Ace High Headline (Spade) 1/4
artworks.artist: Alberts Products Company; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Small bottle neck label, painting that has been cut out with the A hanging halfway off of the background. Blue sans serif monoline letters, with gold and yellow outlines. 1 of 4 labels with the Ace High brand. Small spade on a card in the background between the two numbers

artworks.title: Ace High Headline (Bubbles) 2/4
artworks.artist: Alberts Products Company; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Small bottle neck label with black stripe and light colored bubbles on it. "Ace High" Blue sans serif monoline letters, with gold and yellow outlines. 2 of 4 labels with the Ace High brand. Gold border with a red stripe along the bottom. Background is light yellow, and there are a few corners above and below the center that probably had a spade card at one point.

artworks.title: Ace High Snappy Lemon Dry (Spade) 3/4
artworks.artist: Alberts Products Company; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Large bottle label. "Ace High" Blue sans serif monoline letters, with gold and yellow outlines. 3 of 4 labels with the Ace High brand. Gold border with a red stripe along the bottom. Background is light yellow, There is a black stripe showing a glass of fizzing soda on a black background with multicolor bubbles rising up and a naked woman sitting on top of the glass. Red italic lowercase lettering on an angle in the center reads "Lithiated". "Snappy Lemon Dry" is in a dark blue with light blue outlines, capitals serif. This seems like a rough version, that was then re-done for the next version.

artworks.title: Ace High Snappy Lemon Dry (Alberts Products Co.) 4/4
artworks.artist: Alberts Products Company; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Large bottle label. "Ace High" Blue sans serif monoline letters, with gold and yellow outlines. 4 of 4 labels with the Ace High brand. Gold border with a red stripe along the bottom. Background is light yellow, There is a black stripe showing a glass of fizzing soda on a black background with multicolor bubbles rising up and a naked woman sitting on top of the glass. Red italic lowercase lettering on an angle in the center reads "Lithiated". "Snappy Lemon Dry" is in a dark blue with light blue outlines, capitals serif. This is the most polished version of the label. On the red stripe on the bottom in yellow translation bold letters read "Alberts Products Co. Portland, Oregon"

artworks.title: Gude's Nu-Tone Mat Kid Dressing
artworks.artist: Gude\'s Inc.; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Silver, Black, Pink and White label, with lots of cool bordering, stars and shines throughout. Center text reads "Gude's Nu-Tone Mat Kid Dressing, Price 50 Cents. Manufactured Exclusively for Gude's Inc". The headlines expand on the bottom and condense on the top (think Star Wars titling), and are mostly drawn in reverse contrast. Borders on the sides have open sections with pink background that would likely have more lettering eventually.

artworks.title: Golden Rule Orange Soda
artworks.description: Rectangle with a yellow background and a gold ruler in the middle on the lable. Gaspipe lettering for the headlines in black reads "Golden Rule, Orange Soda". The "R" in this gaspipe style is particularly rare, it breaks all of the rules for this style and is much too heavy, but ruler shows text in red written on a curved path: "Refreshing, Wholesome, Nutritious, Invigorating". Pencil marks are still visible for the bottom text. There is a small black border and a white edge around the whole graphic.

artworks.title: Peanut Butter Kelly Peanut Co
artworks.artist: Dixie; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; The Kelly Peanut Company
artworks.description: Small painted label with a black background and a green three tone stripe near the bottom. The top half of the background is a rainbow of green, yellow, and orange. "Peanut Butter" headline on the top is on an arch with black letters and yellow outlines. In the center of the label is a circle brand "Trademark Registered Dixie Brand". Small text is written in Blue, and the bottom reads "The Kelly Peanut Co. Boston, Mass", in white.

artworks.title: Kia-Ora Orange Squash
artworks.description: Large rectangle with white border, and citrus ifilled border design along the top. The bottom third of the label has a dark blue background with a pile of oranges and lemons, as well as a tall glass of orange juice with an orange slic on the rim and a large stir stick. Lettering for the headline reads: "Drink Kia-Ora (Key-Orah) Orange Squash, Serve Ice Cold". Kia-Ora is a serif monoweight capital style in Red with black outlines. Two small text sections (one on either side of the main headline) are in blue. On the left: "The Health Drink, sold all over the world", and on the right: "Real Fruit Juice and Sugar". Throughout the graphic you can see various different uses of the small bracketed serif capital letters, some condensed, some bold and outlined, some reversed out of the background. The citrus border along the top half of the graphic is a pretty awesome addition to this label. Oranges and lemons with green leaves, blue outlines, and some white branches that seem to intentionally fall out into the background.

artworks.title: It's Pure Orange Concentrate
artworks.description: Large layout with dark blue background on the top, and light yellow background on the bottom. There is a condensed connected script in the top left corner with quotes: "It's pure", Headline on the bottom half in red uppercase condensed letters reads "Orange Concentrate". The bottom corners of the graphic have flowering orange tree leaves. There is a thin green border around everything and dark blue around the outside of the label. The center top of the graphic is a glass fruitbowl full of oranges and lemons.

artworks.title: Nedlog Root Beer (Extra Creamy)
artworks.description: 1 of 2 labels for Nedlog Root Beer. Large label layout with white margin that has tape residue and pencil marks. Headline "Nedlog" in uppercase with white block serifs with black drop shadow heading right (not the convention in lettering/signpainting). Background is a fade from blue to white to red that spans the whole graphic. Single line yellow scroll in the center reads "Root", and "Beer" on seperate lines with banner curling behind on the edges. Small italic red text reads "Extra Creamy". Tall rectangles with white and yellow borders and light blue backgrounds take up large areas of the graphic, likely to be filled in with other information.

artworks.title: Nedlog Root Beer
artworks.description: 2 of 2 labels for Nedlog Root Beer. Large label layout. Headline "Nedlog" in uppercase with white block serifs (pencil marks seen in the N) with black drop shadow heading right (not the convention in lettering/signpainting). Background is a fade from blue to white to red that spans the whole graphic. Seperate but glued on top yellow scroll in the center reads "Root Beer" with banner curling forward on the edges. Printed glued on stripe of black along the bottom with white italic typed letters: "Prepared by the Nedlog Co. 3224 N. Elston Ave. Chicago 18, ILL. Entire label is wrapped in plastic cover and taped on the back.

artworks.title: Pride Brand Jelly
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Puritan Preserve Company
artworks.description: Large oval label drawn on rectangle cardstock with registration marks and color notes in the margins. Yellow then grey striped borders around the outside, with black background and a plethora of fruits along the top half of the label. Headline in white uppercase letters with bracketed serifs reads: "Pride Jelly". There is a green shape in the center that will likely have type on it with the product name. Along the bottom in red uppercase block letters on a curve reads:"Puritan Preserve Co. San Francisco, California, U.S.A". Pencil notes on the margins say that this will be reduced by exactly 1/2.

artworks.title: Boyden's Wildwood Honey
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; The Boyden Company
artworks.description: Large white label with gold stripe, and a yellow tall rectangle along the right side with black and gold borders and a Monogram badge on the top. Badge has a red background with a Monogram in white aht reads TBCo. (The Boyden Company). The main graphic is on the left half of the label. Headlines are in Black with Gold outlines, with a stripe in the middle with red letters on a gold background. the graphic depicts two bear cubs knocking over a large bucket of Boyden's honey, and generally chilling on a black and red background. This is surrounded by various flowers and a red tagline below that just says "Fancy". Corners on the right side show tape residue.

artworks.title: Golden Harvest Beer Crete Brewery
artworks.description: Rectangle label with yellow sun background on the top half, and a brown wheat field on the bottom half. In the center lower half, there is a blue scroll wrapped around two bunches of wheat, with white lettering reading "Golden Harvest". The style is clunky and geometric, no curves, and what you could classify as a terrible "r". An extended capital version of this style reads "Beer" on a red background just below the scroll. Crete Brewery is written in a script along the bottom with some other text in black, including the bottom right: "Permit Nebraska ????"

artworks.title: Crescent Beer Overland Beverage Co.
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Overland Beverage Company
artworks.description: Smaller red rectangle with a yellow section along the bottom. Headline is in white with Crescent moon shaped C, with black outline on white monoweight letters. The E shapes have the atypical C shape for the left side of the letter. There is a large beer in a glass with foam in the center of the label behind the headline text. The rest of the text is written in what looks to be a straightforward redrawing of the typeface Hobo. Overland Beverage Co. Inc. Nampa, Idaho.

artworks.title: Old Mission Ginger Ale
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; San Luis Bottling Works
artworks.description: Black, White, and Gold label with a pencil drawing of an old mission seen inside a stone archway. "Old Mission" is drawn on a curve with hints of translation, uncial, and blackletter in design, Gold with black outline and drop shadow. A rounded black bar with white letters across the bottom half of the label, with gold label with black text and some flag shapes above and below reads: "No Foam, Ginger Ale, No Capsicum". San Luis Bottling Works, San Luis Obispo, Calif. Gold border around label.

artworks.title: Mount Signal Strawberry Soda (Diamond)
artworks.artist: Calexico Bottling Works; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Small diamond shaped soda label, Headline reads Mount Signal Brand, with blue uppercase sans serif letters and light blue outlines on an arch. The background is a desert scene with cactus on the sides, lots of shrubs, some yellow dirt, and light purple mountains in the distance. Center reads "Strawberry Soda" (Imitation) in a condensed uppercase style with blue letters. There is a red thin scroll near the bottom with light blue outlines and white text reading "Calexico Bottling Wks". In the bottom corner in blue is the town: Calexico Calif. with some small pinstriping designs in orange.

artworks.title: (blank) Beer (In oval, sketch) 1/2
artworks.description: Pencil drawing on a transparency mounted onto heavy cardstock. Label design has been folded in half in order to trace the plants on the sides on both sides. There are a lot of guidelines on htis draphic that dont make it into the painted version. Lettering "Beer" in the middle has mid stem spurs, serifs, and a clunky R leg that gives it some piratelike characteristics. 1 of 2, this is the pencil sketch on tracing paper.

artworks.title: (blank) Beer (In oval, painted) 2/2
artworks.description: Beer label with no other words on it, with a yellow background, and green, white, and red borders. Orange oval shape in the middle with a blue border and curled edges. The Lettering "Beer" in the middle has mid stem spurs, serifs, and a clunky R leg that gives it some piratelike characteristics. The letters are white with blue outlines, and brown drop shadows, with the letters larger in the middle to fit into the Oval shape. 2 of 2, this is the color version of this layout.

artworks.title: (blank) Beer (rainbow background)
artworks.description: Blank Beer label with small black and red stripe on the top, and large black and orange bar across the bottom. The center is light yellow, with an upside down rainbow of light colors underneath a Beer headline. "Beer" is drawn with serifs, and letters that flare on the bottom, White letters outlined with blue shape, which is outlined in light blue, and then black. Bottom stripe has a white rectangle over it, where more text would go. The bottom black bar has a gread repeating illustration of a leaf, then a hop (Very stylized).

artworks.title: Golden Fruit Pure Orange Juice
artworks.description: Black label with gold border, and orange leaves and flowers along the corners. Arched headline in gold with orange drop shadow reads "Golden Fruit". The center of the label is a detailed painting of an orange with texture and shading, and small gold lines eminating from it. On the orange it reads "Pure Orange Juice" in a loosely spaced uppercase style.

artworks.title: Pale Face Dry Ginger Ale
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Safeway Stores Inc.
artworks.description: Rectangle label with dark and light blue borders, a dark blue box with the headline text on the top, and a half circle of yellow on the bottom half of the label. The background shows a few tables of party goer's, with a band in the middle, and some splotched and wiggly lined colorful stuff, showcasing a party going right. In the foreground there is an Native American stereotypical Chief on the left, and a Tuxedo wearing, cane holding, top hatted white man on the right (they are looking at each other unimpressed). Professor Tuxedo has been replaced, with a new piece of cardstock attached over the label, and then matched with all of the same colors and design. Headline Text "Pale Face" is a bold sans serif capital red letters with yellow outline. The "Ginger Ale" text below is dark blue with light blue inline and white drop shadow. "Safeway Stores Inc" was apparently the producer of this product.

artworks.title: Sunset Club Strawberry Soda
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Sunset Bottling Company
artworks.description: Small label with blue border and lots of pencil marks. The background image is a scene of a family golfing in front of a large house, with yellow light rays in the sky. Headline text across the top reads: Sunset Club, in a red, triangle serifed roman capitals. Main text reads: "Quality, Strawberry Soda, Bottled by Ledgerwoods Bottling Works, Sherman. Calif", in various styles with a blue shaped outlined in orange. Pencil reads: Sunset Bottling Co. Size 2 1/2 x 3 3/4. Lehmann S.F.

artworks.title: Magnus California Crushed Strawberries (Oval)
artworks.description: Large Oval label, white and green border with a black background. The top has a painting of mixed berries and a pineapple in a glass bowl, with a pear and an orange alongside. Headline reads Magnus California, in white. All of the lettering is upright roman. Smaller label lettering has been glued on, with the headline "Crushed Strawberries", in a swamp green color. Tape residue on the borders

artworks.title: Rainier Dry Ginger Ale
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Rainier Brewing Company
artworks.description: Glossy Black rectangle label, the top half is a painting of Mt. Rainer with snow and some trees, and a detailed golden frame around it with shading to look like a painting in a frame. The bottom half has the text, with a large Rainier script with heavy bottom sections and a swashy capital, as well as a tail swinging under the script. Text reads: "Rainier Pale Dry Ginger Ale, Rainier Brewing Co. San Francisco. U.S.A." All text except for the script is monoline capital block lettering. Paper is stuck to the red script logo that is obstucting it.

artworks.title: Windsor Dry Ginger Ale
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Windsor Beverage Company
artworks.description: Black and gold label for Windsor Ginger Ale. Black border with dark gold ornate bordering and a gold background. In the center is a painting of an estate with an orange sky, bordered with the same dark gold ornate decorations. Text reads: "Windsor Dry, Extra Pale, Ginger Ale, Bottled by Windsor Beverage Co. Los Angeles, Calif". Headline lettering has black capital serif letters with white drop shadow, and an A with the triangle for a crossbar. The ornate bordering is raised from the label for texture.

artworks.title: Italian Club Sodas Root Beer
artworks.description: Small rectangle label with green white and red thin borders. Blue background on the top with white lettering in bold Roman Capitals. Painting of a beach with a mountain with smoke coming off of it, and pilars on both sides. In the center in capital blue letters reads: Root Beer. along the bottom in a small red section with yellow letters, text reads: "Italian Country Club, Los Angeles - Calif".

artworks.title: Olympic Dry Ginger Ale (sketch, Atlas in O) 1/3
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Olympic Dry Ginger Ale Company
artworks.description: Pencil sketch for an Olympic Dry Ginger Ale label, with atlas inside the O, doing some kind of disc throwing/stretching/dance move. Sketch shows the some roman capitals with spured serifs, a loopy M, and generally a swashy and organic look, with a thin outline around it. Text reads" Olympic Dry Ginger Ale, Olympic Dry Ginger Ale Co." 1 of 3 labels. Some glue residue, smudges and dirt are visible.

artworks.title: Olympic Dry Ginger Ale (sketch, Atlas under O) 2/3
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Olympic Dry Ginger Ale Company
artworks.description: Pencil sketch for an Olympic Dry Ginger Ale label, with atlas underneath the O, holding it above his head. Inside the O you there is a mountain and some grassy hills. Sketch shows the some roman capitals with spured serifs, a loopy M, and generally a swashy and organic look, with a thin outline around it. Text reads" Olympic Dry Ginger Ale", and there are lines below to put smaller text. 2 of 3, small glue residue on right bottom corner.

artworks.title: Olympic Dry Ginger Ale (Painted) 3/3
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Olympic Dry Ginger Ale Company
artworks.description: Painted label with silver border, and purple and blue tile patterns inside that. Background is white, with some blue shaded mountains. Olympic headline is silver with purple outlines. Dry Ginger Ale is a serifed roman bold lettering style. Glued onto the bottom is a blue cardstock box with purple lettering inside about the bottling company. In the bottom right there is a painting of Atlas holding his ribs proudly with one hand, and with the other, holding a silver wreath with blue string attached.

artworks.title: Spizz, Carbonated Sparkling Water
artworks.artist: Dr. Pepper Bottling Company; Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company
artworks.description: Light blue label with a dark blue bottom section. Lettering for headline "Spizz" is drawn in a extra bold geometric capital style with jagged edges that looks a bit like an abominable snowman cartoon. Lettering is white with blue drop shadow, and bubbles around it. Below that is a clunky script, "Carbonated" in white. There is a wobbly "Fried Egg" shape around the headlines. "Sparking Water" is in a gaspipe style lettering with center lines pushing out the back left of the stems. There is a fountain in the background, and the bottom text reads "The Dr. Pepper Bottling Co., of Kentucky, Inc. Louisville, Kentucky. There is a quote along the left side that reads: It Mixes, and How!".

artworks.title: Ohio State Ginger Ale
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Ohio State Bottling Company
artworks.description: Silver labels (2 different labels on one black backing page) with white and black flower design borders, and "The great seal of the state of Ohio". Larger label: Across the center with text: Ohio State, written in white capital condensed sans serif letters on an uphill red line. Ginger Ale is written in a simple loose scripte with slightly swashed capitals. Below reads: Bottled by The Ohio State Bottling Co. Cleveland, Ohio. The label has been die cut so that the seal is sticking out halfway off the label on the top. Smaller Bottleneck label: Silver with the same seal and border. The lettering "Ohio" and "State" are written on either side of the seal, red with black outlines, serif bold roman capitals.

artworks.title: Orange Cola
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Southland News Company
artworks.description: Rectangle with light brown thin border, and an illustrative left and right side showing oranges in trees. The center of this label is a large orange with shading and navel, with white Title case lettering, with black outlines and an orange drop shadow. Orange Cola headline is a monoline friendly sans serif with an "r" that is just a line with a ball terminal next to it, not connected. Bottom text reads "Manufactured and bottled for Southland News Company Chattanooga, Tennessee". Small text on the top says "Wholesome - Refreshing".

artworks.title: Orange Frost
artworks.description: Small rectangle label with snowy icicle border around a blue background. The headline text reads "Orange, Frost", with both in Orange (color), and the Frost with white outlines/snowy texture. Text reads "Made from concentrated juice of fresh ripe caifornia oranges and lemons, pure cane sugar and clear sparkling water, benzoate of soda-trace, artifical color added.

artworks.title: Pico Creme
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Orange Crush Bottling Company
artworks.description: Rectangle label with a blue and gold striped border, and light brown background. Headline "Pico" in red capital bold letters with blue oulines on a gold scroll with a chain coming off the bottom, and a line of stars below it. The center of the label is a raised and enlarged penny with no text on it, above what looks like a rosemary sprig painting in the background. "Creme" is written in a large connected script, with an overlapping C that looks like a lowercase e.Printed text that appears to be metal type is glued to the bottom half of the label. Text reads: "Purest material and modern methods combine to make this the ideal beverage for all occasions. Bottled and gauranteed by Orange Crush Bottling Co. of Los Angeles". Small pencil in the bottom corners says Lehmann S.F. and the top corner in pencil says "Over".

artworks.title: Overland Burton Type Ale (half pencil sketch)
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Overland Beverage, Inc.
artworks.description: Life size oval made on transparency paper, with color on the left side, and the rest drawn with pencil. Border is silver, then three black stripes.Monogram on the top in a red circle with white letters reads OB co. Heavy bottomed script "Overland", and all of the text is in black. Burton Type is in a simple uppercase straight letter, with "Ale" a more interested block serif condensed and spurred style, very looseley spaced. Bottling Text: " Overland Beverage Inc. Nampa, Idaho.

artworks.title: OBCO Pilsener Type Beer (half pencil sketch) 1/2
artworks.artist: Lehmann Printing and Lithography Company; Overland Beverage, Inc.
artworks.description: Skewed rectangled shaped label on transparency paper, with the right third of the graphic in full color (the rest is in pencil). All lettering on the label design is in a forward slant to match the label shape. The background is light blue on top and fades to white on the bottom. OBCO is drawn as an uppercase reverse contrast, with black letters and gold outlines. "Pilsener Type" is a red subhead in the center of the design, drawn in a connected script. "Beer" is in uppercase blue letters, with expansion contrast. There are swoopy shapes looping around both sides of the centered lettering, which looks a little like cloud shapes. Bottling info: Overland Beverage Co. Inc. Nampa, Idaho.

artworks.title: OBCO Pilsener Type Beer (small) (half pencil sketch) 2/2
artworks.description: Small bottleneck label on transparency paper, with the right half of the graphic in full color (the rest is in pencil).The background is light blue on top and fades to white on the bottom. an illustration shows a bottle of beer with two glasses, (It shows the larger label stuck on the bottle at an angle so that the letters are upright)."Pilsener Type" is a red subhead in the center of the design, drawn in a connected script. "Beer" is in uppercase blue letters, with expansion contrast. There are swoopy shapes looping around both sides of the centered lettering, which looks a little like cloud shapes.

artworks.title: Black Text 1/4 ABC
artworks.description: Title says "Black Text", and there are about half of the Uppercase Characters Drawing with in a Heavy Black weight, with many thin lines and curling stroke endings. Many letters have a white line down the stem, but not all. the B has half circle details that later show up on all of the letters in the pasteup. Many letters make significant changes between this large drawing, and the Pasteup. Paper is oversized and taped pages extend the sheet. Pencil notes: 8 1/4, page 70.

artworks.title: Black Text 2/4 PSQ
artworks.description: Part of "Black Text", with half of the Uppercase Characters, starting with PSQ. Heavy Black weight, with many thin lines and curling stroke endings. Many letters have a white line down the stem, but not all. the S has half circle details that later show up on all of the letters in the pasteup. Many letters make significant changes between this large drawing, and the Pasteup. Drawn Text on the bottom of the page reads "No attempt was made to maintain uniformity in size of letters here". Paper is oversized and taped pages extend the sheet. Pencil notes: 8 1/4, Page 71. RLG Monorgram with Copyright symbol and the year 37.

artworks.title: Plug Manuscript, Ornamental Manuscript
artworks.description: "Plug Manuscript", D-5 Speedball Pen, Ornamental Manuscript". The first line shows low contrast lowecase upright italics with long ascenders/descenders. The second line shows a connected script version of the same style, with different shapes for g,r,s,y to work as a script. Below that are a full set of capitals with swashy stroke endings and more curvy shapes. There is a pasted on smaller example of wider more roman Capitals, with small serifs. There are also numerals with curvy stroke endings. Small monogram says 1939. Pencil marks: Page 9, 7 1/2.

artworks.title: Roman, Showing How New Alphabets are Created
artworks.description: large black posterboard, with an example in the center of some simple Roman capital shapes, then six examples that show different ways to stylize them. The text in the borders reads: "Showing how new alphabets are created, Designing modern letter styles with the simple roman characters as a working base". The examples show various serifs, inlines, decorative linework and a rounded bold with curling serifs and permendicular curved lines. This example sheet is detailed around the borders, black borders with white ink detailing. The top left corner example is torn along the headline. Overall, this is a great show piece, with great examples of George’s work, a layout pasteup, some fun bordering, and content about making variations in a Roman style. Dated 1933, with a RFG Monogram.

artworks.title: Vanitie Roman, Larger Version
artworks.description: Vanitie Roman, The version that is drawn much larger. Text in the cter of the page reads: "These letters are first sketched with a pencil, then inked, using the two sizes of Style ’B’ pens". This style has wide hollow stems, with a large dotted round line in the middle. There is a lot of white space because of the hollow stems. The stroke endings are curved serifs that split at the stroke endings. some letters have curling shapes, like the A,C,G. Overall this display style is light on the page, and pretty elaborate, definetly display style only. Very stylized lowercase k, and y. pencil marks on the top read "8 1/4 high". There is cut paper glued over most of the lowercase.

artworks.title: VICO Wooden Letters, part of The Vico Collaboration (Portfolio 4)
artworks.description: Portfolio of 10 letterpress prints using Vico wooden letters, shown here is print 11; Greenwood Press, San Francisco, CA; inside a yellowish folder, with a G and upside down V printed sideways. Portfolio includes: 1) Title Page: Top right corner, "VICO wooden letters" 2) Excerpt from Giambattista Vico's New Science, 1724: Two large text blocks, one in Italian, one in English, excerpt titled Corollaries concerning Tropes, Monsters and Poetic Transformations 3) NeN (wind whistles): Small "N" printed next to an upwards facing red "e" on a large black N with small "wind whistles" printed underneath 4) HyH5a (plants making love): Small blue "H" along a large sideways "y", on top of a large H and 5, small "a" on the side, small "plants making love" along left 5) G N (eyes of needles): Large slanted G, large yellow fragment at its side, small sideways N underneath, small "eyes of needles printed at the slant 6) 2yO (brow of a hill): Tall sideways red 2, large black O underneath, overturned y with "brow of a hill" text underneath 7) COCv (head for top): Small sideways C, large sideways O and backwards C above overturned V, small "head for top" printed in the break of the C 8) M ffi (fields were thirsty): Large black overturned M, large sideways "ffi" in yellow in bottom right, small "fields were thirsty" printed at their base 9) 5SQam (vines going mad): Large black sideways S, bordered by a tall 5, large red a and sideways Q, small "vines going mad" along the a 10) yO (beard of wheat): Mirroring y and large transparent O pair, small "beard of wheat" under the first y 11) PISeM (waves murmur): Large black P above large upside down M, blue S and large e on left of M, with small "waves murmur" along right 12) UKHapS (vein of rocks): Large upside down U bordered by sideways H, small red p, sideways K, large a and S along right, with "vein of rocks" printed along the S 13) colophon: Top right reads "Ten prints in an edition of twenty printed on French Rives BFK mouldmade paper at The Greenwood Press by Jack W. Staffaucher. 'Vico wooden letters' was made using an assortment of sixty-six wooden letters that were given to the press in 1966 by The Williams Printing Company of 300 Broadway, San Francisco. For years these 19th century letters were used by the company to print public posters. Also used in this edition are Kis & Meridien types. May 2003, Suite number 1, Jack W. Stauffacher" 14) The Vico Collboration; explanation of the principles of Vico's New Science: Pasted reproduction of an engraving by Domenico Vaccaro on left side of page, bulleted explanation of the engraving on the right Created in Collaboration with Dennis Letbetter.

artworks.title: Vico Duodecimo Axiom 65 (Portfolio 5; 10 pieces)
artworks.description: Portfolio of 10 prints, shown here is print number 5. Inside a yellowish folder, with pasted nameplate reading "Vico duodecimo Axiom 65", Greenwood Press, San Francisco, CA 2006 1) Title page: Title in top right, above a small photo of a folded piece of paper, 2) Giambattista Vico The New Science, 1725 duodecimo 1730 duodecimo 1744 quarto: Black and white reproduction of a contact sheet of Kodak 400TX showing a physical copy of Vico's New Science and some of the lead type blocks used to print it 3) Vico Duodecimo, Axiom 65: Imprinted grid of 12 squares with small blue numbers in their corners, text blocks in the center two squares and title boxes above them 4) t, "LXV 239 This was the order of human institutions...": Large sideways red t, small photograph of a New Science volume, text block underneath 5) fl, "Thus we observe in the Latin language...": Slanted photograph of New Science volume, large upside down red fl alongside it, text block underneath 6) "for the oak produces the acorns...": Text block above 3 angular blue shapes surrounding a photograph of a New Science volume 7) "Later on, at a time when vulgar letters had not yet been invented...": Centered text block above 3 symmetrical yellow shapes, small photograph underneath of hands holding open a volume of New Science. 8) L, "so the presence of the people was the lex...": Text block on the right, large upside down golden L through the middle, lower left has a negative photograph, a close up excerpt of an engraving portrait. 9) y, "Finally, collecting letters, and making...": Small slanted photograph of a New Science volume, large red sideways y underneath 10) Colophon: Small sideways blue G with right oriented text block of Colophon

artworks.title: Wooden Type Experiments "Red 2s"
artworks.description: Large yellow filing envelope with "RED 2s" written in top right; Collection of 17 prints of large wooden type 2 with variations of inking methods and color variations, 12 signed and numbered (backside, bottom right corner), 3 signed and unnumbered, 2 unsigned and unnumbered. Shown here is print number 14. (CB2) Very light transparent red and black 2 with thick black bars and streaks running across parts of the number (CB4) Two transparent red and black 2's overlapping each other, one sideways upward 2 overlapping (CB5) Three very transparent red and black 2's, overlapping each other, one 2 sideways at the right (CB7) Two ghost prints overlapping, one turned on its side, different textures created by solvents and rainbow rolls (CB8) Three pink and gray ghost prints of 2's speckled with white liquid like spots, an additional very transparrent 2 behind them (CB9) Very transparent red 2 with light dabs of blue ink spread and blended throughout the number (CB10) A red and gray 2, like the previous but darker, and similarly has had solvents used in the inking process to scratch and muddle areas of color into light and purplish hues (CB11) A pastel pink and gray 2 with areas of solvent scraped along the ink to create white drip areas (CB12) Red and black gradient 2 with small pools of solvents spotting areas, on upper half of page (CB13) Light red and gray 2, with splatters of solvent, creating lighter areas of muddled color, liquid-like textures (CB14) Light red transparent 2, horizontal waves of darker blue ink dripped onto areas of the types (CB16) Very light red 2, white specks of sovent peppered across the 2, few areas of light grey wash streaks – Upside down transparent black 2, over an upside down red 2, with a sideways upward black 2, dark red sideways upward 2 underneath, signed – Three 2's upside down at different angles, overlapping, with varying transparency and all with puddles of solvents in different areas of the 2, signed. – Two sideways upward, slightly transparent 2's resting on two side by side 2's – Almost opaque sideways downwards 2, slightly intersecting a sideways upward 2 beneath it – Two black, almost opaque, sideways upward facing 2's, overlapping in the center of the page

artworks.title: ma5 Prints (16 Prints)
artworks.description: Collection of 16 Prints, various repetitions of m, 5, and a; inked and arranged differently. 4 signed and numbered (on backside in bottom right), all prints signed. Shown on the Online Archive are prints 8 and 14. 1) Numbered CB1. Large sideways upward facing 5 below a sideways downward facing m; extremely transparent large N, O and m in the background 2) Numbered CB14. upside down extremely transparent a next to a very transparent 5, spotted with solvent drops 3) Numbered CB16, very transparent upside down a next to a large 5, down to the left of them the same pair is repeated slightly less transparent upside down and reversed, exxtremely transparent 5's and a's overlapping in the background 4) Numbered CB20, Very transparent upside down a next to large bold transparent 5; subtle shapes within the characters. 5) m5 and a upside down a running horizontally down center of the page, with the same trio running horizontally upward and overlapping the first. Very transparent N's and O's in the background 6) m5a running horizontally downward, intersecting m5a running horizontally upward, all repeated 3 times and overlapping; two very transparent, slightly warm toned, m's in top right and bottom left 7) m5a in transparent black running horizontally upward on left of the page, more transparent black and blue m5a running horizontally downward on the right 8) m5a in transparent black running horizontally downward, with slight blue tint in the mm5a running horizontally upward on the left, with areas of blue in each character; extremely transparent large N's in the background 9) m5a printed twice overlapping horizontally downward, m5a printed horizontally upward, with blue tint in the 5; red angled a's in lower half of the page; large very transparent N's and m's in the background 10) m5a running horizontally downward, with different textures and varying transparency, intersecting m5a running horizontally upward; printed on top of an upside down red m in the center of the page, extremely transparent N and O in the background 11) m5a running horizontally upward, repeated twice with repetitions overlapping, m5a running horizontally downward, repeated 3 times, repetitions ovelapping, one printed in yellow; rows of small angled pairs of S's in top right and bottom left corners 12) Dark, overlapping black m's facing all four directions, filling most of the page; yellow m's printed underneath 13) 5am printed horizontally running upwards, red 5 facing up in the center; m5a running horizontally downward in yellow on the right; 3 N's and O's printed very transparently in the background 14) m5a printed horizontally running downward, with solvent streaks running through the characters, another horizontally downward m5a underneath in yellow; two upside down a's in red at top and bottom of the page; extremely transparent and solvent streaked m5a running horizontally up the left side 15) m5a printed horizontally upward twice in a blackish yellow and overlapping itself; printed underneath in transparent black, m5a printed horizontally running downward, signed in bottom left 16) m5a printed sideways running downward in very transparent black, another printed slightly to the right and overlapping the first. A third printed in a grayish yellow overlapping on the right; one m5a printed sideways running upward in a grayish yellow 17) Labeled "Wooden type experiements On & Off Inking. Black Ink 4 June 1990"

artworks.title: Tea Room
artworks.description: Two book blocks, each Japanese stab bound (3-hole) with thread-stitching, joined together by white paper covers; offset printed on Hanga Kouzo Kawachi paper; signed and numbered by the artist. The work is housed in a wooden box. The first block on the left-hand side contains excerpts from The Book of Tea (Fox Duffield & Company, New York, 1906) by Kakuzo Okakura, mainly exploring the history and aesthetics of the tea room in Japanese culture. Text is in English, Japanese, and German. Also included are diagrams illustrating different dimensions of tatami-mats. The second block on the right-hand side presents graphics (paste glue, dyed with tea leaves) in geometric constructions that resemble compositions of tatami rooms. Interwoven into these images are short personal quotes by the artist creating a dialogue with the original text. "This book was created as a semester-project on the subject of 'memory' in the class for book art at Burg Giebichenstein University of Art and Design Halle. It was supervised by Prof. Sabine Golde and Stefan Gunnesch."--colophon
